name: Edgewater Commons

description: Edgewater Commons stands as the dominant retail destination in Edgewater, New Jersey, strategically positioned on River Road, the area's primary retail corridor. This 426,864 square foot shopping center serves as a vital community hub in the New York-Newark-Jersey City metropolitan area, offering residents convenient access to department stores, well-known clothing retailers, home-goods shops, and casual dining options. The center's prime location provides easy accessibility for the densely populated surrounding communities, drawing from a trade area of over 2.3 million people within 5 miles. Currently fully leased with a waitlist for future availability, Edgewater Commons demonstrates strong market demand and tenant confidence in this thriving retail corridor. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, the property benefits from professional management and maintains its position as the go-to shopping destination for the affluent Edgewater community and surrounding areas.
